rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (shingles on porch overhang) with no third-party involvement or theft is straightforward property damage.
claim_summary: Jordan Lee (POL-1006) reports wind damage to back porch overhang, with approximately four shingles blown off last weekend. Estimated repair cost is $400 with no water intrusion into the home. Note: claim falls below the $2,500 deductible.

case_facts.description: wind damage, four shingles blown off
